shape.assignment_key: SHA256 of sorted assignee UUIDs, latest meaningful assignment/reopen audit event, and reopened_at

storage.legacy: No field means acceptance not recorded; never infer it from alert/read/work/history.

acceptance.cycle: UUID or empty before first explicit cycle

rules: Only currently assigned named account with tasks.view and tasks.perform; no admin override when unassigned.
Accept only not_started/in_progress/returned; current membership required before idempotent replay.
Accept changes task version and audited metadata, not work status, findings, alert read_at, notifications, assignments or permissions.
Changing assignee set resets the entire cycle; changing only schedule/priority retains it. Reopening a general task resets cycle; earlier acceptance remains in audit snapshots.
Read-only details/list show acceptance independently; existing execution/submission remains permitted without acceptance to preserve legacy workflows.
Existing fieldwork_operations receipt stores task reference; retry returns current authorized task without resubmitting or restoring earlier acceptance.

Current acceptance is proven only by matching accept_task_assignment audit actor/cycle/entry/original revision+1; no matching origin means not_recorded. The assignment fingerprint also rejects old UI131 reassignment/reopen, including ABA.
integration: Load task_acceptance.js/css before task_workspace.js in both shells and SW.
No new tables, routes, notification settings, permissions or outbound messages. Existing task backup/transfer boundaries apply.
limitations: No native or graphical browser test in this local round.
No global schema migration: old UI131 writers retain fields, and UI132 revalidates their assignment/reopen history instead of trusting retained metadata.
